description: From now on, mail from this contact to the address they are a contact of goes to spam, by the contact’s `id`. Their mail to your other addresses is unchanged, and what already arrived stays where it is (move it with `update_message`). For a sender who is spamming or abusive, or when you were asked to. A person undoes it, on Contacts or Rules.
name: block_contact
title: Send a contact’s mail to spam
